status: D58.11 local solder-side exclusion; remote strobe driver remains open
observation: The right-facing notch and four-corner registration identify the lower-right joint of the D58 2x10 solder field as pin11. In the original close-up this crown has no visible B.Cu trace leaving it. The broad lower strip passes about 50-60 pixels below the joint without a visible join; the distinct next joint to the right has a conspicuous solder-side spur onto that strip. Thus the photo does not support merging D58.11 into the broad +5 V strip or using that strip to identify timing tag 5's driver.
limit: The component-side trace and plated-hole continuity are hidden by the installed package and camera angle. This local solder-face exclusion does not identify the remote tag-5 endpoint; direct continuity or a readable exact-revision continuation remains necessary.
